items.html: And the ascent of these Hassadim requires no time, for immediately, from the force of the great haste of the descent, they return and ascend in a moment to the upper third of the Tifferet of ZA, where is the corona of the Yesod of Tevunah. And from the force of this ascent, which they made within that upper third itself, they found there the two Hassadim and the third that are covered, and then they grew them and light was added to them; for their root stands in the corona of the Yesod of Tevunah, and from there they send their light to the two arms through the partitions of the crown (Atara) of Tevunah, as mentioned, for there, in the upper third of the Tifferet, is the Atara of Tevunah, and there is the branching and division of the two arms.
